Meanings are from the eBL dictionary (largely based on CDA – Black, George & Postgate, A Concise Dictionary of Akkadian). Stem-specific meanings (G, D, Š, N…) follow the main gloss.

-a I

abāku II

  • Meaning: "to overturn, upset" O/jB
    • G: (a/u); also transf., omen, divine verdict, witchcraft
    • D: ~ G
    • N: pass. of G
  • Lines: 70
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ab%C4%81ku%20II

abātu I

  • Meaning: "to destroy"
    • G: (a/u, O/jB also i'abbat, i'but (cf. GAG §97h)) objects, buildings; living beings; OA "ruin (economically)"
    • D: "destroy completely" objects, parts of body, living beings; jB occas. + eli instead of acc.
    • Dt: pass. of D [GUL.MEŠ]
    • Š: caus. of G OB(lit.)
    • N: pass. of G (forms cf. GAG §97j)
  • Logograms: GUL.MEŠ
  • Lines: 68
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ab%C4%81tu%20I

adi I

  • Meaning: "until, as far as" [EN]
  • Logograms: EN, A.RÁ
  • Lines: 115
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/adi%20I

adānu I

  • Meaning: pl. f. "fixed date, time limit" Bab. (Ass. cf. edānu) [UD.DUG4.GA; U4.SUR] ūm a. "fixed day"; jB ina lā a. "at the wrong time"; astr. "period"; eqel a. "objective"
  • Logograms: UD.DUG4.GA, U4.SUR
  • Lines: 1, 111
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ad%C4%81nu%20I

adāru I

  • Meaning: "to be dark, gloomy"
    • G: (a/u) j/NB [KA≈GI6]; of day; of gods, people; of heavenly bodies "become obscured"; of plants ?
    • D: O/jB "darken", esp. stat. with pānū/ī "look gloomy"
    • Dt: jB, NA "become gloomy"
    • Š: "darken" j/NB, NA
    • N: "become dark"; astr. "become eclipsed" [KA≈GI6] OB, j/NB
    • Ntn: iter. of N jB
  • Logograms: KA≈GI6
  • Lines: 40
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ad%C4%81ru%20I

adāru II

  • Meaning: "to be afraid (of), fear"
    • G: (a/u) NB ēnē a. 'fear the eyes' = "with an eye to, in consideration of"
    • D: "frighten" OA, jB
    • Štn: iter. of Š O/jB
    • Št: pass. of Š
    • N: "become restless, worry about" OA, OB, jB
    • Ntn: iter. of N OA, OB, jB
  • Lines: 48
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ad%C4%81ru%20II

ahu II

  • Meaning: "arm, side" (st. constr. ah(i))
  • Logograms: GÚ
  • Lines: 17
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ahu%20II

ahāzu I

  • Meaning: "to take; marry; learn"
    • G: (a/u)
    • Gt: "be connected with; well versed in"
    • D: (OA infin. also ehhuzum) "mount, plate, inlay" with metal, stone (< ihzu denom.) [GAR(.RA)]; "marry" pl.
    • Dt: pass. of D
    • Štn: "instruct, inform s.o. repeatedly"; OB of disease "infect repeatedly"
    • Št1: OB "be instructed, incited"?
    • Št2: lex. "ignite" fire, "make" fire "catch"
    • N: pass. of G 2 "marry each other"; of fire etc. "catch, spread";
  • Logograms: GAR, GAR.RA
  • Lines: 30, 75, 95
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ah%C4%81zu%20I

ahītu I

akālu I

  • Meaning: "to eat"
    • G: (a/u) [GU7]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [GU7.GU7]
    • Gt: of lands "ravage each other"; of stars "cover, absorb each other"
    • Š: caus. of G [GU7] "make" men, animals, fire "eat, feed on, consume" food, medication, goods, booty, lands; "steep" an object in liquid; OA "satisfy" a claimant; jB stat. "is infected" with a disease
    • Št: [GU7] OB math. "multiply together", freq. "square" measured lengths N pass. of G [GU7]
  • Logograms: GU7, GU7.GU7
  • Lines: 19
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ak%C4%81lu%20I

alpu I

  • Meaning: "bull, ox" [GU4; coll. pl. GU4.HI.A; NA usu. GU4.(NÍTA.)MEŠ]; a. mê, a. nāri "water, river ox"; a. kīši "water buffalo"? jB; a. šadê (a wild animal) Am.; a. epinnim "plough ox"; a. warkatim [GU4.(Á.)ÙR.RA] "rear ox (of team)"; math. pūt alpim 'ox's forehead', i.e. "trapezoid" [SAG.KI.GU4]
  • Logograms: GU4, GU4.HI.A, GU4.MEŠ GU4.NÍTA.MEŠ

alû II

  • Meaning: (an evil demon) M/jB, Bogh., NA [A.LÁ; occas. U18.LU];
  • Logograms: A.LÁ, U18.LU
  • Lines: 71
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C3%BB%20II

alāku I

  • Meaning: "to go"
    • G: (illak, illik; perf. ittalak (cf. GAG §97n)) [DU]
    • Gtn: [DU.DU] "go, come repeatedly; roam about, wander", muttallik mūši [LÚ.GE6.A.DU.DU; (LÚ.)GE6.DU.DU] 'who walks around during the night' = "night-watchman"; OB of leg muscles "twitch persistently"
    • Gt: "go off, away" (cf. GAG §92e) differentiation between pret. of Gt and perf. of G difficult
    • Š: caus. of G [DU] with abstr. noun ending in -ūtu or adv. "make s.o./s.th. (become)" s.th.; stat. "is appropriate, suitable" [TÚM.MA]
  • Logograms: DU, IGI.DU, DU.DU
  • Lines: 113
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81ku%20I

amāru I

  • Meaning: "to see"
    • G: (a/u) [IGI; IGI.DU8]
    • R: Mari
    • Gtn: iter. of G; Mari stat. "has learnt thoroughly"
    • Gt: jB "see from now on"?, mng. uncl.
    • D: rare; OA "examine" metal; cf. mummertu
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "make s.o. meet" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G [IGI; IGI.LÁ]
    • Ntn: iter. of N 1
  • Logograms: IGI, IGI.DU8, IGI.LÁ
  • Lines: 11, 14
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/am%C4%81ru%20I

amšāli I

  • Lines: 39

"various"; NA a(n)nûte ... a(n)nûte ... "some ..., others ..."; (a)kī (h)anni(ma) "thus, in the same way";

arāku I

  • Meaning: "to be long" [GÍD(.DA)]

"bad; unfavourable; hostile; unhealthy";
  • Logograms: DÙG DÙG.GA
